mechanics_summary: 400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ146. The user flicks a small tracking Hakai Ki orb that follows the opponent; the orb disappears if the user is hit, while a successful connection produces a large explosion. Additional input before the final hit creates an unblockable explosion. Current research also documents an approximately 20-second active lifetime; exact frame data and patch-independent damage remain unresolved.
boundaries: Exact frame data, current damage scaling, and precise tracking/interruption parameters remain unresolved.
